subject: model: fix decode args error for ddls executed on older version of TiDB (#64421)
summary: Adds a JobVersion1 `ActionRenameTables` decode fallback when the trailing `oldTableNames` argument is missing (seen in <=8.1 where `Job.DecodeArgs` in schema-diff code could truncate and then persist args without the last element), preventing a slice-index panic in `GetRenameTablesArgsFromV1`. Includes a regression test that simulates the truncated-args encoding. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched meta/DDL decode path; upstream/master keeps the same logic.
